algorithm_title: Find all elements that appear in 2 separate unsorted lists ensuring the result contains no duplicates
evidence_summary: This suite provides partial behavioural evidence using one predefined common behavioural test, with partial state-mutation evidence. Embedded list cases are fixed; the helper function is not invoked through an external contract by the current program runner.
coverage_basis: Assessment is based on the predefined common behavioural test, the behaviours exposed by the frozen program interface, and the declared coverage dimensions: state mutation.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret behavioural accuracy as useful but incomplete evidence across the declared exercised behaviours; unexercised behaviours remain outside the direct evidence.
